IRB Policy
fields.options: The University prioritizes integrity, responsibility and accountability in all research activities, from design to execution to dissemination. Researchers should follow ethical standards,  obtain necessary permits, acquire informed consent from the participants, protect participant rights and ensure transparency. Violation of research ethics will terminate the project and the researcher can be liable for disciplinary action or any other appropriate measures.

fields.options:
Animal Ethics Committee reviews applications for experiments conducted on animals as part of their research work. Any proposal that intends to use live animals in the lab or field as part of their work, should fill up this form. Work involving mammals (examples: rodents, primates etc.) in the lab is not permitted at Azim Premji University.

Students/Researchers whose work involves transgenic cells and animals should apply separately to the Institutional Bio Safety Committee (IBSC).
